description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance scores for five different models: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClnGS (w/), and ClnGS. The horizontal axis displays the model names in an unspecified order, while the vertical axis represents “Average Performance” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at 10-unit intervals. Five individual bars are present, each corresponding to a model. The “Standard” model is represented by an orange bar extending to approximately 52, the “Self-RAG” model is represented by a grey bar extending to approximately 55, the “FactTune” model is represented by a green bar extending to approximately 50, the “ClnGS (w/)" model is represented by a blue bar extending to approximately 58, and the “ClnGS” model is represented by a dark blue bar extending to approximately 59. No bars are visually emphasized, and there are no groupings or stacking of bars.
